title: Korean-Style Agemono with Portuguese Sausage and Pear
description: A fusion dish that combines the crispy exterior of agemono with the flavors of Korean Gochujang and the sweetness of pear, all wrapped up in a Portuguese sausage
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Portuguese sausage and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the crushed agemono and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the diced pear and cook for another 2-3 minutes, until the pear is slightly caramelized.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Gochujang and soy sauce (if using).
Pour the Gochujang mixture over the pork and pear mixture, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions.
Optional: Sprinkle with Korean chili flakes for added heat.
